name: icon-button
title: IconButton
description: A square, icon-only action button with Button's four variants in three density-aware sizes, disabled and loading states, and a required aria-label.
usage: Use IconButton where a familiar icon says enough and space is tight: toolbars, table rows, inside an InputGroup. Put an <svg aria-hidden> inside and describe the action in aria-label ("Copy connection string", not "Copy icon"); the type requires it. Ghost is the default; use primary for the one main action of a toolbar. When the icon is not obvious, use a Button with text instead.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name: what the button does. Required by the type.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight, the same colours as Button's variants.

props.name: size
props.description: A square of size.control.*, which follows data-density; the icon is size.icon.sm (md at lg).

props.name: loading
props.description: Running: aria-busy and data-loading, ignores clicks, stays focusable.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element (a link) with the button's props.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The button; data-slot="icon-button", data-variant, data-size and data-loading name it.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: The child icon, sized to size.icon.sm (size.icon.md at lg).

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over the button: the variant's hover colour.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: a ring of ring.width in color.ring, offset by ring.offset.

states.name: loading
states.description: Running: aria-busy, ignores clicks, stays focusable.

accessibility: Renders a native <button> with type="button" unless type is set, so Enter and Space activate it.
aria-label is required by the type and names the action; mark the icon aria-hidden so it is not read twice.
Disabled uses the native disabled attribute; loading keeps the button focusable so focus is not lost mid-action, and sets aria-busy.

The smallest size (size.control.sm, 22 px in compact) passes WCAG 2.2 target size (minimum 24 px) only with spacing around it; keep IconButtons at least gap-inline-xs apart, or use md in dense toolbars.
The focus ring shows for keyboard focus only and meets 3:1 against every surface; every variant's colours are contrast-checked by the token build.
